# Synthetic outline store, index contract kpc-outline-store-index/3

Made with the outline store tool "full 3" (zip sha256 d78803cb578a3063bfd3109283f2d28e707663afa110a57862e5e82b1f3df0be): its own
StoreWriter wrote these files from made-up squares. No real park outline is in them. Two areas, US-ZA and US-ZB:
- US-9101: one publishable record; US-9102: not publishable (licence not read); US-9103: marked wdpa_derived (no WDPA words in
  any value); US-9150: one tract in each area (the combined index.json keeps only the US-ZB entry, as the tool does today);
  US-9201: one publishable record in US-ZB.
Used by tests/test_fers_store_nov13.py.
